{{Term/Store|Guardian Scout II|Guardian Scouts II|Series, BotW|plural}} are [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{BotW}}.<ref>{{Cite|'''{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|Guardian Scout II}}'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
{{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Scout II}}
The Guardian Scout II is a version of the [[Guardian Scout]] that can be found within "A Minor Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s, where [[Link]] is tasked with defeating them in order to complete the shrine. They also appear in several other Shrines.

Guardian Scouts II are upgraded versions of the [[Guardian Scout I]], with the added capability of wielding weapons.<ref>{{Cite|In addition to the beam functionality, this particular model was designed to handle weaponry as a means of further testing the combat prowess of one undertaking the trials.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> They are typically equipped with either a [[Guardian Sword]], [[Guardian Shield]], [[Guardian Spear]], or [[Ancient Battle Axe]], which they will drop when defeated.

A unique, translucent blue Guardian Scout II appears in the [[Ta'loh Naeg Shrine]]. Unlike others of its kind, this one is only defeated once Link strikes it with a Charged Attack after he is instructed to do so, regardless of how much damage it has taken prior.
